Budding Lookout.name: Budding Lookout
Budding Lookout.description: The user buds a working eye, ear or mouth at the tip of a limb and slides it around a corner, through a cracked door or into a gap in rubble. They see or hear from the tip while their body stays behind cover, and a budded mouth lets them talk a trapped person through the wait; a blow to the bud hurts the user, and it sinks back when they let it go. Strain: moderate.
